Black—Victini and Reshiram | enva=[[Tom Wayland]]| java=[[Misato Fukuen]]| }} '''Leeku''' (Japanese: '''リーク''' ''Leeku'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a minor character who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. ==In the movies== Leeku was a participant in a tournament held in [[Eindoak Town]]. He battled {{Ash}}'s {{AP|Tepig}} in the tournament with his {{p|Samurott}}. Despite nearly defeating the Fire Pig Pokémon, Leeku lost the battle when Tepig managed to defeat Samurott with a {{OBP|Victini|M14}}-powered {{m|Ember}}, eliminating him from the tournament. {{-}} ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Leeku |pkmn=Samurott |type1=Water |img=Leeku Samurott.png |epnum=M14 |epname=White—Victini and Zekrom
